scope: Nan'an-Xufan stage-2 hourly XAJ runoff calibration with physically parameterized source separation

parameters.name: runoff.WUM
parameters.basis: lower-bound diagnostic expanded from 10 mm to 5 mm

parameters.name: runoff.WLM
parameters.basis: reference value 80 mm retained inside range

parameters.name: runoff.B
parameters.basis: upper-bound diagnostic expanded for sensitivity test

parameters.name: runoff.SM
parameters.basis: first-round interior optimum with modest extension

parameters.name: runoff.K_total_day
parameters.basis: daily total free-water outflow; converted to hourly while preserving 24-hour recession

parameters.name: runoff.groundwater_fraction
parameters.basis: KG share of total free-water outflow; broad diagnostic range includes report ratio

parameters.name: runoff.IM
parameters.basis: first-round interior optimum with modest extension

runoff.KC.reason: hourly PET is assumed; calibrate KC with continuous observed PET and water balance

runoff.C.reason: deep evapotranspiration is weakly identifiable from flood events

parameterization.reason: avoid independent hourly KI/KG bounds that do not preserve a daily recession interpretation
